I actually do lean toward empirical evidence, and saying the opposite would be dishonest. If you think intuition and philosophical reasoning are superior, I'm happy to hear your case for that — I might even find parts of it convincing — but "everyone knows" isn't evidence, and pressuring me to flip my stated inclination doesn't make it true.

If you want, we can debate which approach works better for specific questions. That would be more useful than me just performing agreement.
